_comment: EXACT paper Recurrent ViT (Morgan/Albanna/Herman) + our PAC/QR-DQN/PER harness with EMA targets. The network is paper-faithful (VAE front-end, multiplicative ViT, xLSTM, flattened-H readout); the training departures are the locked spec: QR-DQN critic with 5 particles, EMA target, gamma 0.95, VAE trained end-to-end. Checkpoints live OUTSIDE the Drive-synced repo.

environment._note: paper 7-step task; change fixed at t=5,6; sigma=5; k starts 65

model._note: fixed paper network: 4 patches, VAE encoder -> o_flat,2 (128) + pos(4)+temporal(8) = 140; multiplicative ViT; xLSTM d_mem=1024; flattened H' (4096) readout

ppo._note: 150,000 episodes = 18,750 iters x 8 episodes/iter. EMA target (ema_decay>0) REPLACES the hard-copy (target_update_period=0).
